column1: # NFTBan ci-bash quarantine registry — v1.226.0 PR-D.
# The ci-bash class is BLOCKING: every non-quarantined ci-bash test must pass. A
# quarantined test STILL EXECUTES and is REPORTED, but is excluded from the
# blocking tally under this audited, expiring policy. Enforced by:
#   * scripts/ci/check-quarantine-registry.sh (metadata validity, BLOCKING)
#   * scripts/ci/run-test-suite.sh --quarantine (execution + failure-pattern binding)
# The runner binds each quarantined failure to expected_failure_pattern (a NORMALIZED
# category substring, matched with grep -F — NOT a raw error string, so paths / line
# numbers / timing / tool versions may vary). It BLOCKS if a quarantined test passes
# (needs reconciliation), its failure category changes (pattern absent), it disappears
# from execution, or the count exceeds the ceiling. A new failure cannot silently enter
# quarantine — raising the ceiling is an explicit, reviewable edit here.
# Origin: PR-C exposed 19 ci-bash failures. PR-D challenged all 19 → 15 were stale/
# obsolete test expectations, corrected test-only (product unchanged); 4 remain, below.
# CONFIRMED_PRODUCT_DEFECT entries are quarantined + registered for a separate
# failure-domain lane; they are NOT fixed in PR-D.
# De-quarantined:
#   2026-07-28  v128_help_code_correlation_test  (V1226-CIBASH-PRODDEF-01,
#     CANONICAL_COMMAND_REGISTRY_DRIFT, lane OPEN_CANONICAL_LOGS_REGISTRATION).
#     The registered product defect — `logs` routed and completion-listed but
#     absent from _nftban_canonical_commands() — is closed by v1.228.1 PR-1
#     (R20). The test now passes in full; a passing quarantined test BLOCKS, so
#     the entry is retired and the ceiling lowered 3 -> 2.
#   2026-11-01  v128_polkit_aware_wording_sweep_test  (V1226-CIBASH-PRODDEF-02,
#     POLKIT_WORDING_DRIFT, lane OPEN_POLKIT_WORDING_REWORD). The 14 root/sudo phrasings are
#     reworded to the polkit wording (v1.236); the one nft_probe.sh case pattern that matches
#     nft's own stderr is allow-listed by line shape in the test. The test passes in full.
#   2026-11-01  botscan_throughput_v187_test  (V1226-CIBASH-ENV-01, MISSING_MATCHER_BINARY,
#     lane OPEN_BOTSCAN_MATCHER_CI_PROVISIONING). The Policy Gates job builds
#     nftban-botscan-matcher before ci-bash (ci-architecture.yml), so the precondition holds.
#   Both entries retired; ceiling lowered 2 -> 0.
# Columns: QT id path owner reason finding introduced review_or_expiry disposition expected_failure_class remediation_lane expected_failure_pattern
QUARANTINE_CEILING=0
